items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 7 at 5:29PM AKDT until May 8 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues to be possible.

* WHERE...Fort Yukon

* WHEN...Through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- The breakup front in Alaska is currently approaching Fort
Yukon and is expected to continue progressing downstream with
potential for small jams to form and minor water level rises.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 7 at 1:35PM AKDT until May 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 1 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can bring hazardous conditions for mariners.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 7 at 12:18PM AKDT until May 8 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Aniak

* WHEN...Through Friday evening.

may impound behind a jam which may cause flooding several miles
upstream.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 6 at 5:22PM AKDT until May 9 at 2:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is occurring.

* WHERE...Chatanika River upstream of road access from Murphy Dome.

* WHEN...through Saturday.

* IMPACTS...An ice jam on the Chatanika River is causing flooding of
some cabin properties along the river. More ice is still coming
from upstream so the flooding may increase before the jam
releases. Several cabins had water and ice surrounding them as of
3pm on Wednesday
